backup.clean_production_save_boundary_before_ac: Separate production cutover archive taken after native clean shutdown and independently restored with all 1612 managed files hash-verified.

overworld_preservation.boundary: Actual independent restore before/after startup/save/shutdown. Partial final-sector padding only was padded after all actual record lengths were verified within original bytes. Section-state equality is not visual, machine, behavior or multiplayer acceptance.

earlier_component_tests.scope: Repository-lock staging before private bridge/Tavern/Easy NPC reconciliation; not full-production preservation qualification

diorama_repair.scope: Actual singleplayer copied-world initialization and native color bake. No rendered-map visual or multiplayer acceptance. Test client terminated after capture because reliable desktop close was unavailable; not a clean shutdown claim.

inventory_expanded.scope: Fresh world, no players copied; initial repository mod set. Inventory client, persistence/removal and multiplayer integrity untested.

fresh_install.first_manifest: all 216 client hashes verified after author downloads; final retained-runtime update checked separately

final_update.scope: Fresh prior manifest installation followed by final retained-runtime/repair update using exact local manifest; all author/GitHub downloads and final file hashes checked. Public channel and native import remain unverified.

optional_cli_behavior.cause: CLIHandler.showOptions unconditionally sets every optionValue to true; CLI option choosing is unimplemented. Headless results do not prove default=false GUI selection.
optional_cli_behavior.action: Use normal Prism GUI optional selection to keep Essential off; owned managed clients and server already exclude optional default-false files.

bsl_enchanted_6g.acceptance: FAIL: current 6 GiB client is under heap pressure and has severe frame stalls. Attempted 8 GiB setting was not applied by cached launcher instance. Not a controlled benchmark.
bsl_enchanted_6g.client_shutdown: Owned disposable client terminated after log capture; no clean exit claim
bsl_enchanted_6g.modset_scope: Initial repository baseline before bridge64/Tavern/Easy NPC reconciliation; component diagnostic only

graphics.8g_test: Reached the copied world after moving the owned instance into the physical Prism instance directory. Initial FPS observations excluded all new resource packs; subsequent Nautilus/Roundista reload froze under full-GC pressure. Failed graphics qualification.
graphics.soft_rounded_runtime: Owner observed improved in-world relief with BSL at depth 0.50 and quality 64; controlled graphics/performance qualification remains open.

8g_runtime_diagnostic.resource_manager_log: Initial 21:16:22 reload contained none of Stylista, Roundista, Nautilus or Fresh Animations. Later 21:21:45 reload included Nautilus, Roundista and Fresh Animations.
8g_runtime_diagnostic.owner_observation: Reported 1-5 FPS with low GPU use, recovery to about 50 FPS with higher GPU use, then a multi-minute freeze when enabling new packs; owner closed the test client.

recovery_observation.scope: 12 uncontrolled live samples during manual play; not an equivalent-scene benchmark

gc_during_freeze.interpretation: Sustained heap exhaustion with repeated full-GC pauses of more than one second. Different interval from the recovered-period JFR.

histogram_during_freeze.boundary: All-object class histogram during failed resource reload; does not identify a unique retaining owner or prove all arrays belong to models.

8g_runtime_diagnostic.shutdown: Owned monitor observed client exit; game log confirms all chunks and dimensions saved before renderer shutdown.
8g_runtime_diagnostic.next_test: 12 GiB heap, Xaero HUD retained and Diorama minimap hidden; no 12 GiB runtime acceptance claim yet.

12g_owner_test.scope: Manual copied-world tests with Stylista and Roundista, Nautilus and BSL; uncontrolled scenes and live shader changes, not a comparative benchmark.
owner_observations: One Xaero HUD and responsive movement.
Roughly 30 FPS during part of manual play.
Roundista relief improved at depth 0.50 and quality 64, with preferred self-shadow samples 16, angle 4.0 and strength 32.
Stylista grass and oak appeared flat after switching back and reloading Iris. The owner directed the issue to remain open.

stylista_probe.boundary: Resource and atlas evidence only; the one-shot probe does not establish visual acceptance.

12g_owner_test.shutdown: Manual test and the subsequent test-only probe each exited through Minecraft with all dimensions saved. The probe is excluded from release artifacts.

open_gates: Native fresh Prism import and final manifest download
Both presets rendered with BSL and DH, including city/interior/model overlap checks
Octo Arms movement/backtank/ship interactions and cart transport/storage
Coordinated production activation and final stable publication

world_file_audit.scope: Offline final reconciled clone compared with all 1,303 original world-file hashes; preservation evidence only, not behavior or visual acceptance.
world_file_audit.dh_database_files: All three original active-world database files byte-identical; empty WAL and shared-memory sidecars removed during normal shutdown.
world_file_audit.other_dimensions: Original Nether and End contain data files but no terrain-region files; no custom-dimension terrain files were present. No non-overworld terrain-preservation claim.
world_file_audit.small_nbt_changes: World time/last-played/trader delay, mod list, generated/fragmentum_layer datapack addition, weather evolution/ticks, raid ticks, global clock and synthetic claim-owner confirmedActivity timestamps only. No original enabled datapack removed.
world_file_audit.changed_regions: One terrain region and one entity region changed during the server run; existing section-state and UUID/type audits cover these separately.
world_file_audit.raw_evidence: Private detailed hash and NBT-field receipts retained with the verified backup; no player identifiers or raw world content published.

changed_region_detail.terrain_difference: 49 LastUpdate timestamps and block-entity list ordering in two chunks only; per-position saved block-entity data identical.
changed_region_detail.entity_difference: Attribute-list ordering on 25 entities; per-attribute-ID values identical. No changed saved entity fields beyond list ordering.

production_recheck.boundary: Current production matched the archived byte hashes. This recheck does not prove the archive was taken at a clean stop.

owner_acceptance.scope: Owner approved production and public Latest with KG-only evidence and directed completion without another join. The unattended staging attempt did not establish a player connection.
